title: AI model inventory & retirement lifecycle
description: Inventories all deployed Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry model deployments across subscriptions, cross-references each model and version against the official Microsoft model retirement schedule, and flags deployments that are already deprecated, approaching retirement, or running on a version with a known successor. Helps teams plan model migrations proactively and avoid service disruptions when deprecated models stop accepting requests.
example_prompt: "List all Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry model deployments across all subscriptions. For each, show: resource name, resource group, model name, model version, deployment name, and deployment date. Cross-reference each model and version against the official retirement schedule at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry-classic/openai/concepts/model-retirement-schedule. Classify each deployment as: (1) 'Retired' — model version past its retirement date, (2) 'Retiring soon' — retirement date within the next 90 days, (3) 'Current' — no retirement date announced or retirement date > 90 days away. For retired and retiring-soon models, show the retirement date, recommended replacement model/version, and the number of days until retirement. Summarize total deployments by status."
